To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) ATOMS is the first program to provide a complete set of crystallographic functionality to XAFS users; (2) ATOMS provides a user interface that is simple and easy to use, but powerful and capable of generating complex input files for FEFF, and; (3) ATOMS can be easily extended to provide new functionality.
ATOMS is an application that provides a range of crystallographic functionality to the x-ray absorption spectroscopic community.

ATOMS is: a user application providing useful crystallographic functionality for the X-ray Absorption Spectroscopist; and a set of reusable software modules written in Perl providing crystallographic function and access to databases.

the development of a software system to provide the x-ray absorption spectroscopic community with crystallographic functionality.
the development of a software package that will be useful to a wide variety of scientists.
the development and implementation of software for the analysis of X-ray absorption spectroscopy and related techniques.
